intro.summary: St Pier Giorgio Frassati was an Italian layman known for his deep faith, love of the Eucharist, and generous service to the poor.

blocks.text: You can pray the full St Pier Giorgio Frassati Novena below.
blocks.title: Introduction

blocks.notes: expanded canonical prayer references into full rosary texts; Changed “St” to “Saint” for clearer text-to-speech pronunciation; otherwise kept wording and structure the same.; converted "mention request here" into a personal-intention pause marker; reused compacted prayer source from an earlier section; converted intention marker into sacred bell and personal-intention pause

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. Saint Pier Giorgio, teach me true poverty of spirit. Help me understand that God cares for me, and that He asks me, in return, to care for others, especially those in need. Guide me to make choices in my life which will show a preference for service of God and neighbor, rather than accumulating financial wealth and social advantage for myself. Give me a special love for the poor and the sick. Saint Pier Giorgio, I ask for your intercession in obtaining from God, Who is the Lover of the poor, all the graces necessary for my spiritual and temporal welfare. I confidently turn to you for help in my present need

Amen. Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Saint Pier Giorgio Frassati, pray for us! In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
